integrity: The universal theorem is proved by locally convergent Mittag-Leffler series, a convexity-in-parameter argument, exact Fourier integration by parts, and the standard Schur and Szego recurrences. A standalone finite checker is supplementary and is not an exhaustive or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Coefficient positivity is established for \(0\le t\le3\) only; the exact endpoint \(t=3\) concerns concavity of the lifted circle density, not a proven optimal upper threshold for positivity. Higher exponent behavior and Verblunsky asymptotics are not determined. Priority relative to uninspected older literature is provisional.
title: Sharp concavity frontier and all-degree Chebyshev positivity for an arcsine-power deformation
